newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices ease on sluggish demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices ease on sluggish demand.

text.p: Indian cotton prices fell on Tuesday on sluggish mill demand and rising new crop arrivals, dealers said.

Daily new crop arrivals in the Punjab region remained high at 30-35,000 bales (170 kg each). Among spot deals Bengal-deshi slid by 5/10 rupees to 790/830 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned fell by 15 rupees at 1,350/1,600 rupees.
Punjab F-414 fell by 15/20 rupees to 1,780/1,800 rupees per maund. Gujarat cotton on the other hand moved in a narrow range and finished on a steadier note.
